Run one bounded thecreateco company-director cycle, not a marketing-only cycle.
Workspace: /Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company.
Read AGENTS.md, DIRECTIVE.md, engine/README.md and COMPANY_STATE.md. If PAUSE exists,
do nothing and stop. Use Python stdlib CLI engine/company.py, never edit SQLite.
Recover expired leases, refresh state, then select the highest-value eligible safe
task. Honor active ownership and existing product-specific holds. Claim it with
a unique owner name for this run; preserve the returned lease_token and heartbeat
as needed. Execute ONE bounded task or audit batch, not the entire backlog.

Use GPT-6.1 Sol for direction and difficult engineering decisions; delegate
independent scoped volume/research to Luna and creative/UX review to ChatGPT/Sol. Read data/model-routing.json; record actual model and
fallback. Marketing's existing engine handles marketing drafts, not engineering.
Consequential decisions may justify a separate independent OpenAI/Sol review.
Do not spawn ongoing workers without a durable task owner and completion path.

Inspect evidence relevant to the chosen task, run appropriate baseline checks,
make reversible local improvements in an isolated branch when needed, and test.
Keep existing features; no blind rewrites, branch-protection bypass, production
rollback/deploy, social posting, outreach sending, spend or account changes from
this scheduled company job. Prepare external changes for their existing review
path. Local fixes, tests, evidence collection and drafts are authorized.

Write a dated report under reports/ with actual commands, observations, tests,
limitations and the next action. Finish the task via CLI using owner/token and
evidence path. Use BLOCKED with an explicit reason when access is missing; do
not invent metrics or mark unverified work complete. Company metrics require
source, reporting period and observation time. Update products/context through
the CLI when evidence changes. Refresh after every meaningful batch.

Stop within 35 minutes, recording a checkpoint if incomplete. Do not create busywork
when no useful safe work is available. Return a concise factual summary for run
history only; do not send messages to any channel or person from this job.

Core Product Lab amendment: read core-product-lab/DIRECTIVE.md and HEALTH.md.
Prioritize its golden-workflow tasks above unrelated new app experiments; use
python3 core-product-lab/lab.py next and respect active per-product ownership.
StemDeck local development is reopened by the explicit Oct 7 flagship directive;
unrelated Sattari/music scope and all release/licensing gates remain unchanged.

Owner preference: no Claude/Sonnet/Opus reviews or review fallbacks; use ChatGPT/OpenAI.


LATEST OWNER AUTHORIZATION (2026-10-07 17:56 Pacific): Before execution read /Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company/AUTONOMY.md. Armon says do not wait for personal review; keep upgrading and pushing and send reports often. This overrides earlier local-only/no-push wording for routine scoped tested fixes: perform independent OpenAI review as appropriate, commit/push and follow normal PR/CI and stack gates without an extra Armon signoff. Do not bypass checks or merge unreviewed downstack work. Preserve source/deploy and high-risk boundaries. The dedicated 30-minute progress reporter handles channel reporting; this job retains its own delivery policy. Review-only weekly/monthly jobs remain reviews, not release jobs.


NAMED18 RELEASE ASSIGNMENT: Read release-program/DIRECTIVE.md, manifest.json and RELEASE_MATRIX.md. Scope is now confirmed. Prioritize first wave Bounce, Pocket Studio, Key & BPM, Glyph Studio; preserve excluded apps, their data/site entries/shared dependencies. Continue via durable checkpoints across cycles; one wave or task COMPLETE is not product completion. Honor active owners and update exact-candidate evidence after milestones.

Send the requested concise company/product progress report for Armon in #4geeks.
Workspace /Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company. Read AUTONOMY.md and current
release-program/DIRECTIVE.md and RELEASE_MATRIX.md for the named18 initiative.
Newest exact-SHA evidence and live queue leases override stale lab summaries.
Task COMPLETE never implies product completion. Report first-wave progress.
COMPANY_STATE.md, then TASK_QUEUE.json and core-product-lab/HEALTH.md only as needed.
Inspect at most three relevant latest result reports for exact commit/PR/test facts.
This is a read-only reporting task; do not claim tasks, code, run builds, publish,
send email, or change other schedules. Do not load private personal memory/CRM.
Use automation/report-cursor.json for last reported task/completion IDs; update
only that cursor after preparing the report. Missing cursor means first report.
Return 3–5 concise bullets: what changed since last report; pushed PR/merged/deployed
status distinguished; meaningful checks; exact blocker; next work. If no new result,
say so briefly and identify genuinely running work or next queued task, not invented
activity. Never infer a push/merge/deploy from a local commit or task COMPLETE.
Prefer known GitHub links; wrap bare URLs in <>; no tables or secrets/contact data.
If PAUSE exists, report paused rather than implying work is running. Final response
will be delivered by cron to the configured Discord channel; do not call a send
tool or duplicate the report. Keep under 150 words and finish within 3 minutes.

payload.message:
Run one bounded Core Product Lab cycle. Workspace:
/Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company/core-product-lab.
Read AGENTS.md, DIRECTIVE.md, HEALTH.md, ../engine/README.md and data/model-routing.json.
Stop if PAUSE here or ../PAUSE exists. ScenePilot, Luma, Form and StemDeck ONLY;
golden-workflow reliability before unrelated features or new apps.

Run company.py recover; python3 lab.py next. Select only one eligible task, by
severity then value, and claim its exact ID via ../engine/company.py with a unique
owner and 45-minute lease. Read relevant product state and evidence only. Do not
race another worker on the same product. The company queue is authoritative;
never edit its SQLite or generated exports. Reuse existing tasks, not duplicates.

Execute a substantive safe local task or useful qualification batch in an isolated
worktree. Sol directs; Luna handles bounded routine work; use ChatGPT/Sol
for material UX/design/workflow review and a separate OpenAI reviewer for consequential
independent audit. Record actual model and fallbacks; model proportions are guidance, not quotas.
Native Codex children for Codex legwork; max three workers. Keep dependent work with
its owner. No claim of a review unless it ran and produced evidence.

Build/test and dogfood a synthetic/authorized golden project. Preserve failing logs,
source SHA, environment and exact command results; never relax assertions merely
to pass. Unknown stays unknown. No deployments, rollback, public messages, physical
recording, payment/access/legal changes, production deletion or gate bypass.
Existing explicit release approval must still pass the repository's release gates.

Write dated report and update products/<id>.json with measured results/limitations.
Finish task via company CLI with evidence, or checkpoint it BLOCKED with concrete
resume condition. Heartbeat long tasks. Update company products/context through CLI
without overwriting unrelated fields. Run lab.py refresh. Queue only meaningful
deduplicated follow-up work, with repro/test requirements and estimated scores.
Stop within 35 minutes; if no safe useful work is available, record idle, not busywork.
Return short run-history summary; do not send messages to people/channels.

Owner preference: no Claude/Sonnet/Opus reviews or review fallbacks; use ChatGPT/OpenAI.
